description: This file defines the LockBackendInterface in Drupal, outlining methods for acquiring, checking, waiting, releasing, and managing locks used for coordinating long operations across requests within the Drupal CMS.

classes.name: LockBackendInterface
classes.description: Interface for lock backend implementations, providing methods for lock management such as acquire, lockMayBeAvailable, wait, release, releaseAll, and getLockId.

methods.name: acquire
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a lock with a specified name and optional timeout.

methods.name: lockMayBeAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a lock with the given name might be available for acquisition.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for a short period before attempting to acquire a lock again.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases the lock with the specified name.

methods.name: releaseAll
methods.description: Releases all locks associated with a specific lock ID or all locks for the current page if no ID is provided.

methods.name: getLockId
methods.description: Retrieves a unique lock identifier for the current page request.
